tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Attaching certificate document regarding the rules under which the organaisation is established/holdingKST/CST/VAT number of the tenderer.
Attaching a copy Of the Licence Held by the authoraised authority that the tenderer is selling food items.
Submitting a recenet affidavit stating that they have not been convitted under the essential material Act and they Organaisation is not Block listed tobe attested by Notary.
Enclosing copy of service tax registration letter.
2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 attaching information and acknowledgement regarding income tax field for the years.
A solvency certificate should be obtained and submitted regarding financial soundness of the Organaisation(minimum 5 lakhs)
2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 Attaching of the certificate obtained from the appropriate authority regarding the submission of sales tax.

The tenderer should obtained and attach a certificate from the previous years transaction. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 year Audit report documents provision and submission of document as per tender documents.
